title: Suicidality screening documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recording that suicidal ideation, intent, support and immediate risk were directly assessed by a competent clinician; it does not populate a negative, assign risk, or generate escalation.
user_facing_items.population: Adults with possible or diagnosed depression; communication and carer involvement are qualified.
user_facing_items.setting: Primary and mental healthcare recognition and assessment.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: England and Wales; international evidence requiring UAE mental-health, crisis, referral, and legal adaptation
restrictions: Exact for documenting mood and interest screening, duration, course, function, social and interpersonal context, sleep, substances, medicines, loneliness and clinician-completed risk assessment. It does not diagnose depression or generate a referral or treatment.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports clinician-completed self-harm and suicide risk assessment for suicidality screening; no decision is generated.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recording the person’s needs, concerns, strengths, vulnerabilities, context and clinician-performed psychosocial assessment without using a prediction score.
user_facing_items.population: Children, young people and adults who have self-harmed, unless a recommendation is age-specific.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, emergency department, hospital and mental-health care following self-harm.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: England and Wales; requires UAE legal and pathway adaptation
restrictions: Exact for compassionate psychosocial assessment, emergency-department initial assessment, immediate safety, safeguarding, willingness for physical and mental care, care-plan status, observation and discharge documentation after self-harm. It does not apply a risk score, predict suicide or generate treatment.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports collaborative psychosocial assessment after self-harm for suicidality screening; no decision is generated.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recording safeguarding consideration and clinician-confirmed assessment, plan, communication and follow-up before discharge after self-harm.

user_facing_items.rationale: Supports safeguarding and qualified discharge context for suicidality screening; no decision is generated.
